From: Tim Owens <tim.owens@medica.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-30 08:12 PST
Subject: Live chat sessions dropping mid-completion — urgent

Laura —

We're seeing a severe issue starting ~07:50 PST this morning where a portion of our users' live chat completions terminate mid-stream. Clients report a spike of 429s and 5xxs, and many of the sessions end with a client-side timeout after ~12–18s of silence. The user-visible symptoms: truncated assistant messages and frequent reconnection prompts.

Quick facts:
- Region: us-west (our users are routed to your us-west nodes)
- Error patterns: elevated 429s (~15% of calls over 30m window), bursts of 500/502 on the proxy tier, and TCP FINs from the client side.
- Correlation IDs attached for a sample: 2c9f4a7b, 2c9f4c31, 2c9f4d02

This is impacting a high-value cohort — we have a board-facing product demo this Friday. Can you triage immediately and advise on any temporary mitigations (rate-limit/rollback) we can accept while you investigate?

I've attached a tarball with client-side logs and a network capture.

Attachments: medica-logs-20261230.tar.gz (application/gzip)

—Tim Owens
CTO, Medica Health

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Tim — thanks for the heads up and the logs. We're on it. Initial plan:

1) Triage: SRE will look at proxy+serving error rates and KV cache health now (Marcus).
2) Short-term mitigation (if we confirm retry amplification): throttle retries and enable per-customer streaming token bucket for Medica to cap fanout.
3) Fallback: if streaming is unstable we can temporarily flip to short-poll completion mode (non-streaming) for Medica's routed requests while we patch.

Can you confirm whether you can accept a 2-hour maintenance window for a temporary throttle? If not, we'll prioritize a non-invasive fallback.

Linking the HubSpot case: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/7821

I'll update with a mitigation within 30 minutes.

—Laura Bennett
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai; evelyn.hart@redwood.ai; jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-30 09:05 PST
Subject: Re: Live chat sessions dropping mid-completion — initial findings

Quick notes from SRE triage (first 20m):
- We see a classic retry-amplification pattern: a subset of client SDK deployments are timing out on streaming keepalive/frames, leading to aggressive client retries. Retries are hitting the front proxy and then the serving fleet, producing 429 bursts under backpressure.
- Proxy logs show increased 499/408-like client aborts for streaming connections (client closed mid-download) and elevated 429s as token buckets exhausted.
- Serving nodes did report transient OOMs on a small pool (NVIDIA-based serving group) around 07:58; those nodes auto-evacuated which increased load on remaining nodes and amplified the 429 signal.

Immediate mitigations we recommend (order of operations):
1) Apply short-term streaming request cap for Medica (per-customer token bucket, 10r/s) — low risk, immediate.
2) Enable idle-keepalive extension (increase server-side keepalive probe to 45s) to reduce false client timeouts.
3) Temporarily deploy a circuit-breaker rule: when a single customer hits >10% 5xx+429 within 5m, route to fallback non-stream path for 5 minutes.
4) Rebalance serving traffic away from the small pool reporting OOMs and roll their driver.

Attachments: slo-dashboard.png (image/png) — shows the 07:50–08:10 spike.

I'll stand by for authorization to push the token bucket and keepalive change. If allowed, I can roll those in the next 30–45 minutes.

—Marcus Lin
SRE Manager | Redwood Inference

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: Tim Owens <tim.owens@medica.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, evelyn.hart@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-30 09:30 PST
Subject: Re: Live chat sessions dropping mid-completion — mitigation plan

Tim — we propose the following immediate, non-disruptive plan:

- Window: start in 30 minutes from now. Estimated time to mitigation: 45–60 minutes.
- Actions:
  • Apply per-customer streaming cap (10r/s) for Medica.
  • Increase server keepalive timeout to 45s (reduces false-positive client timeouts).
  • Enable temporary circuit-breaker to route impacted users to non-streaming fallback for 5m if error rate spikes again.

Expected impact: reduced retry storms and fewer truncated completions. The streaming UX will be throttled for a small percent of sessions during the window; full streaming will be restored after we stabilize the serving pool.

Please reply with a quick "Proceed" or let us know constraints. We'll proceed with emergency changes if we do not hear back in 15 minutes given impact level.

—Laura

- Short remediation plan (customer-facing, ETA):

  2) Add server-side graceful-retry logic to avoid immediate 429 escalation on transient node drains — ETA: 7 days (engineering prioritization required).
  3) Improve SDK keepalive/backoff defaults (prevent aggressive client retries) — ETA: 14 days.
- Commercial: recommend offering a 10% service credit for usage between 2026-12-30 07:45 PST and 2027-01-02 16:00 PST. This is aligned with the impact and helps preserve the renewal momentum.

Questions for leadership:
